+package info
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"
+)
+
+// Flipt contains build and update information exposed by the HTTP API.
+type Flipt struct {
+	Version         string `json:"version,omitempty"`
+	LatestVersion   string `json:"latestVersion,omitempty"`
+	Commit          string `json:"commit,omitempty"`
+	BuildDate       string `json:"buildDate,omitempty"`
+	GoVersion       string `json:"goVersion,omitempty"`
+	UpdateAvailable bool   `json:"updateAvailable"`
+	IsRelease       bool   `json:"isRelease"`
+}
+
+// ServeHTTP serializes Flipt's build information as JSON.
+func (f Flipt) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+	out, err := json.Marshal(f)
+	if err != nil {
+		http.Error(w, http.StatusText(http.StatusInternalServerError), http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+
+	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+	if _, err := w.Write(out); err != nil {
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusInternalServerError)
+	}
+}

+	status int

diff --git a/telemetry/telemetry.go b/telemetry/telemetry.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9ecb755
--- /dev/null
+++ b/telemetry/telemetry.go
@@ -0,0 +1,284 @@
+// Package telemetry reports anonymous Flipt installation usage.
+package telemetry
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+	"net/http"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/gofrs/uuid"
+	"github.com/markphelps/flipt/config"
+	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus"
+)
+
+const (
+	// Version is the version of the telemetry state and event schema.
+	Version         = "1.0"
+	eventName       = "flipt.ping"
+	reportInterval  = 4 * time.Hour
+	stateFileName   = "telemetry.json"
+	segmentTrackURL = "https://api.segment.io/v1/track"
+)
+
+type state struct {
+	Version       string `json:"version"`
+	UUID          string `json:"uuid"`
+	LastTimestamp string `json:"lastTimestamp"`
+}
+
+// Reporter sends anonymous usage events and persists the per-installation ID.
+type Reporter struct {
+	logger    logrus.FieldLogger
+	state     state
+	statePath string
+	client    *http.Client
+	endpoint  string
+	mu        sync.Mutex
+}
+
+type trackEvent struct {
+	AnonymousID string                 `json:"anonymousId"`
+	Event       string                 `json:"event"`
+	Properties  map[string]interface{} `json:"properties"`
+}
+
+var (
+	versionMu    sync.RWMutex
+	fliptVersion = "dev"
+)
+
+// SetFliptVersion sets the version attached to subsequent telemetry events.
+// The executable calls this with its build-time version before creating a reporter.
+func SetFliptVersion(version string) {
+	versionMu.Lock()
+	defer versionMu.Unlock()
+	if version == "" {
+		version = "dev"
+	}
+	fliptVersion = version
+}
+
+func currentFliptVersion() string {
+	versionMu.RLock()
+	defer versionMu.RUnlock()
+	return fliptVersion
+}
+
+// NewReporter initializes telemetry state and its HTTP client when telemetry is
+// enabled. A nil reporter is returned when telemetry is disabled or the state
+// directory is a file.
+func NewReporter(cfg *config.Config, logger logrus.FieldLogger) (*Reporter, error) {
+	if cfg == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("telemetry config cannot be nil")
+	}
+	if !cfg.Meta.TelemetryEnabled {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	if logger == nil {
+		logger = logrus.New()
+	}
+
+	directory := cfg.Meta.StateDirectory
+	if directory == "" {
+		configDirectory, err := os.UserConfigDir()
+		if err != nil {
+			err = fmt.Errorf("locating user config directory for telemetry: %w", err)
+			logger.WithError(err).Warn("initializing telemetry; telemetry disabled")
+			return nil, err
+		}
+		directory = filepath.Join(configDirectory, "flipt")
+	}
+
+	statePath := filepath.Join(directory, stateFileName)
+	current, disabled, err := loadState(directory, statePath, logger)
+	if err != nil {
+		err = fmt.Errorf("initializing telemetry state: %w", err)
+		logger.WithError(err).Warn("initializing telemetry; telemetry disabled")
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if disabled {
+		logger.Warnf("telemetry disabled: state directory %q is not a directory", directory)
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+
+	return &Reporter{
+		logger:    logger,
+		state:     *current,
+		statePath: statePath,
+		client:    &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second},
+		endpoint:  segmentTrackURL,
+	}, nil
+}
+
+func loadState(directory, statePath string, logger logrus.FieldLogger) (*state, bool, error) {
+	if info, err := os.Stat(directory); err == nil && !info.IsDir() {
+		return nil, true, nil
+	} else if err != nil && !os.IsNotExist(err) && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+		// ENOTDIR means a parent component is a file, which also makes this
+		// configured state path unusable.
+		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "not a directory") {
+			return nil, true, nil
+		}
+		return nil, false, err
+	}
+
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(directory, 0700); err != nil {
+		return nil, false, err
+	}
+
+	loaded := &state{}
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(statePath)
+	if err == nil {
+		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, loaded); err != nil {
+			logger.WithError(err).Warn("reading telemetry state; generating a new anonymous ID")
+			loaded = &state{}
+		}
+	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
+		return nil, false, err
+	}
+
+	changed := false
+	if !validUUID(loaded.UUID) {
+		id, err := uuid.NewV4()
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, false, fmt.Errorf("generating anonymous telemetry ID: %w", err)
+		}
+		loaded.UUID = id.String()
+		changed = true
+	}
+	if loaded.Version != Version {
+		loaded.Version = Version
+		changed = true
+	}
+	if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, loaded.LastTimestamp); err != nil {
+		loaded.LastTimestamp = time.Time{}.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
+		changed = true
+	}
+	if changed || errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
+		if err := writeState(statePath, loaded); err != nil {
+			return nil, false, err
+		}
+	}
+
+	return loaded, false, nil
+}
+
+func validUUID(value string) bool {
+	parsed, err := uuid.FromString(value)
+	return err == nil && parsed.String() == strings.ToLower(value)
+}
+
+func writeState(path string, current *state) error {
+	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(current, "", "  ")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	data = append(data, '\n')
+	if err := os.WriteFile(path, data, 0600); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return os.Chmod(path, 0600)
+}
+
+// Start begins the reporting loop. It reports immediately when no successful
+// report has occurred in the previous four hours, then waits four hours between
+// attempts. Cancellation stops the loop and any in-flight HTTP request.
+func (r *Reporter) Start(ctx context.Context) {
+	if r == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	go r.loop(ctx)
+}
+
+func (r *Reporter) loop(ctx context.Context) {
+	delay := reportInterval
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	if last, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.state.LastTimestamp); err == nil {
+		if remaining := reportInterval - time.Since(last); remaining > 0 {
+			delay = remaining
+		} else {
+			delay = 0
+		}
+	} else {
+		delay = 0
+	}
+	r.mu.Unlock()
+
+	for {
+		timer := time.NewTimer(delay)
+		select {
+		case <-ctx.Done():
+			timer.Stop()
+			return
+		case <-timer.C:
+		}
+
+		_ = r.Report(ctx)
+		delay = reportInterval
+	}
+}
+
+// Report sends one anonymous flipt.ping event. The state timestamp is advanced
+// only after the telemetry endpoint accepts the event.
+func (r *Reporter) Report(ctx context.Context) error {
+	if r == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	err := r.report(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		r.logger.WithError(err).Warn("reporting anonymous telemetry")
+	}
+	return err
+}
+
+func (r *Reporter) report(ctx context.Context) error {
+	r.mu.Lock()
+	defer r.mu.Unlock()
+
+	properties := map[string]interface{}{
+		"uuid":    r.state.UUID,
+		"version": Version,
+		"flipt": map[string]string{
+			"version": currentFliptVersion(),
+		},
+	}
+	event := trackEvent{
+		AnonymousID: r.state.UUID,
+		Event:       eventName,
+		Properties:  properties,
+	}
+	data, err := json.Marshal(event)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("encoding telemetry event: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, r.endpoint, strings.NewReader(string(data)))
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("creating telemetry request: %w", err)
+	}
+	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+
+	response, err := r.client.Do(request)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("sending telemetry event: %w", err)
+	}
+	defer response.Body.Close()
+	_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, response.Body)
+	if response.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || response.StatusCode >= http.StatusMultipleChoices {
+		return fmt.Errorf("sending telemetry event: endpoint returned %s", response.Status)
+	}
+
+	r.state.LastTimestamp = time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
+	if err := writeState(r.statePath, &r.state); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("persisting telemetry state: %w", err)
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+package telemetry
+
+import (
+	"context"

+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func testLogger() *logrus.Logger {
+	logger := logrus.New()
+	logger.SetOutput(io.Discard)
+	return logger
+}
+
+func TestReportPersistsAnonymousPing(t *testing.T) {
+	previousVersion := currentFliptVersion()
+	t.Cleanup(func() { SetFliptVersion(previousVersion) })
+
+	var received trackEvent
+	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, r.Method)
+		require.Equal(t, "application/json", r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
+		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&received))
+		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
+	}))
+	defer server.Close()
+
+	stateDirectory := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "state")
+	cfg := config.Default()
+	cfg.Meta.StateDirectory = stateDirectory
+	SetFliptVersion("v1.2.3")
+
+	reporter, err := NewReporter(cfg, testLogger())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, reporter)
+	reporter.endpoint = server.URL
+	reporter.client = server.Client()
+
+	statePath := filepath.Join(stateDirectory, stateFileName)
+	var before state
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(statePath)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &before))
+	assert.Equal(t, Version, before.Version)
+	assert.NotEmpty(t, before.UUID)
+	assert.True(t, validUUID(before.UUID))
+	assert.Equal(t, time.Time{}.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), before.LastTimestamp)
+
+	require.NoError(t, reporter.Report(context.Background()))
+	assert.Equal(t, before.UUID, received.AnonymousID)
+	assert.Equal(t, eventName, received.Event)
+	assert.Equal(t, before.UUID, received.Properties["uuid"])
+	assert.Equal(t, Version, received.Properties["version"])
+	assert.Equal(t, "v1.2.3", received.Properties["flipt"].(map[string]interface{})["version"])
+	assert.Len(t, received.Properties, 3)
+
+	data, err = os.ReadFile(statePath)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	var after state
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(data, &after))
+	assert.Equal(t, before.UUID, after.UUID)
+	assert.NotEqual(t, before.LastTimestamp, after.LastTimestamp)
+	_, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, after.LastTimestamp)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
